HiveMind Smart Onboarding

Project Lead & UX/Information Architecture Designer — HiveMind Academy × Ravensbourne University London, Jul–Aug 2026

A 4-week work-based learning placement with an EdTech startup, in a 5-person Product Discovery Squad designing the core user journeys for an AI-powered onboarding platform. I led the team and owned the information architecture end to end.

  • Designed the initial information architecture and user journey map, then re-scoped it after stakeholder feedback showed the original plan was too narrow — updating the linked hypotheses and test tasks to match.
  • Co-built the high-fidelity UI screens, a small design system, and an interactive Figma prototype with a fellow designer.
  • Coordinated and observed usability testing with 5 working professionals, and ran a discovery interview that fed into 10 validated pain points.
  • Result: 100% task completion across the 3 tested tasks, and self-reported confidence moved from 3.4 to 4.8 / 5. HiveMind's CEO selected the prototype as the strongest submission.

TripPlanner

Full-Stack Developer — Ravensbourne University London module project, 2026

A trip-planning web app built for my full-stack module: multi-destination itineraries, planned-vs-actual budgeting, and a role-based admin panel. I designed and built every screen myself, then deployed it live.

  • React front end with a Node.js/Express REST API, PostgreSQL database and Prisma ORM, JWT authentication and role-based access.
  • Personal dashboard with spend-by-category and planned-vs-actual budget views; auto-generated trip summaries as downloadable PDFs.
  • Designed and coded the whole interface myself, so I've done the "screen becomes component" step directly rather than just in theory.
Live site GitHub

Intelligent Waste Classification & Recycling Guidance

Computer Vision and AI module, custom CNN built end to end, 2026

A waste-sorting app backed by a convolutional neural network I designed, trained and evaluated myself, then deployed into a small web app that gives recycling guidance from a photo.

  • Own dataset pipeline across 15,515 images and 10 classes, with a stratified train/val/test split and augmentation.
  • Found and fixed a real training bug — rescaling was destroying the images before augmentation — then retrained to a healthy learning curve.
  • Reached 72.2% test accuracy, evaluated with a full confusion matrix and per-class metrics, not just a headline number.
  • Deployed locally with a live demo: upload a photo, get a classification and recycling guidance, with a low-confidence flag when the model isn't sure.

EcoCart

Product Analyst, Virtual Internship — Bright Network / IEUK Skills Project, Summer 2026

A concept for an AI-powered retail app that scans receipts and turns what's about to expire into recipe suggestions, aimed at cutting household food waste.

  • Defined the MVP and product strategy, then wrote a PRD with Agile user stories and KPIs.
  • Designed the wireframes across three flows: on-device receipt scanning, an expiry-tracked pantry, and an AI recipe generator.
  • Built a 10-slide stakeholder pitch deck covering the ecosystem, competitors and go-to-market plan.

CheapFlix

Personal full-stack project

A budget movie-streaming concept built to practise a complete flow: browsing a catalogue, comparing plans, and checking out — with a real backend behind the interface, not just static pages.

  • HTML/CSS/vanilla JS front end with a Node.js, Express and MongoDB backend served through Nginx.
  • Login and registration modals, a browsable movie catalogue, and three tiered subscription plans with their own feature sets.
